description.value: Summerhill Pyramid Winery is Canada's only Demeter-certified biodynamic vineyard, founded by the Cipes family in 1986 on 17 hectares above Okanagan Lake in Kelowna. The property is anchored by a replica Egyptian pyramid cellar built to sacred geometry proportions, used to age the winery's 100% organic wines. Cyclists can browse the retail wine shop, dine in the bistro with panoramic lake views, or arrange a tour of the pyramid — a genuinely singular stop in the Okanagan wine country.

address.value: 4870 Chute Lake Road, Kelowna, BC V1W 4M3
